<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_ProductDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product Idea to Prototype Approval" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" name="Idea identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductResearch" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility study">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype from available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Prototype approved?" default="Flow_Discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_ConductResearch" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ConductResearch" targetRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refinementNeeded == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retest" name="Reinitiate testing" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
